nodes.does: data retries, transient re-runs, restarting stopped machines — each fix verified the next hour

nodes.name: Fixer machine
nodes.does: Goes into every problem the supervisor finds: data behind → starts a retry; a failed run → reads its log, re-runs it once if the cause was transient, else writes up the exact error as a task. Re-runs only, never code, max 3 a day per workflow
nodes.learns: Learns from its own runs: what changed since last time, what failed, what to repeat

nodes.name: Supervisor
nodes.does: Watches every machine: alive, late or stopped, and each one's score week on week
nodes.learns: Learns each machine's normal rhythm and flags anything late or failing
